title: Grateful Dead Live at Community War Memorial Auditorium on 1973-09-26
lineage: SBD: Rm > DAT > CD / Patched with unknown AUD > WAV > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a jazzy 1973 Buffalo show with standout Weather Report Suite and vibrant horn guests, though the audio has some splicing quirks.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its peak‑year groove, free‑jazz excursions and the added sax/trumpet colors on the Eyes > Weather Report Suite, making it a high‑energy highlight of the era. The soundboard source is generally listenable but suffers from audible splicing, loose tape sections and quirky track breaks that keep the recording from being pristine.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance with many standout moments outweighs moderate technical issues; weighted average yields a solid 4+ rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Notable AUD splicing, loose SBD tape sections, and quirky tracking (e.g., Let It Grow split across tracks); overall decent but not high‑end.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set builds to a horn‑enhanced Eyes > Weather Report Suite, delivering a jazzy, experimental climax; the show flows smoothly despite occasional tape quirks.
